Bank Employment 2802 views Q. I have a question regarding taxi cabs in Chicago. Is it allowable to tranport drunk passengers? Let me explain you the situation here: During morning shifts(5Am to 5PM) the passengers are mostly those going to office, airport or shopping malls. But during evening shifts, customers are mostly going to Bars/Pubs/strip clubs. There are certain streets which have bars one after the other. Going on those streets means you are going near bars. Also cabbies line up outside famous bars/pubs. If you want to avoid these customers you have to take small streets where you are almost certain of not getting any customers. Then to pick up customers you have to go to office areas which will be very far. After 11PM there is hardly anyone else on the streets other than drunk revelers. Another issue you can consider is that if anyone is trying to flag you down, you cannot refuse them. But that is just a rule and can be conveniently broken. In short avoiding bar areas is feasible but you make 1/3rd of what other people make. 2137 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 40886 Country: India Title: About Investment in Mutual fund in India Question: I want to invest in Mutual Fund through ICICI Bank where the risk of heavy loss is too. Is it ok to invest in Mutual Fund because there is no fund of Interest? I also want to know that according to current market scenario. What kinds of investment are correct according to Islam? Please guide me. Answer ID: 40886 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 795/777/N=1433) (1) We learnt after research regarding Mutual Fund that the members have no option to opt for share of the company or business which they wish rather the authority has full right to invest in the company and the business which it wishes. It is most probable that your money is invested in a company involved in unlawful and haram business, hence you should not invest in it. (2) Currently there are various ways prevalent for investment. You should write the complete details of the one which you consider better and suitable as per your condition in order to know the Shariah ruling. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
